node.statement: Writing X=sum_i E_{i1} tensor x_i with each x_i in S_{P,Q}, one has B=sum_i E_{i1} tensor x_i in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}; applying dagger gives A_0=sum_i E_{1i} tensor x_i^dagger in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}. These are exactly the membership conclusions obtainable by entrywise linear algebra.
